findings.summary: sendUsdcGasless is the only action without an outer catch: policy failures (deny/expired/context-drift/duplicate ref) reject the invoke() promise instead of returning a structured failure string. Enforced on the tested head; fixed and maintainer-confirmed on the PR (outer-catch repair shipped in 15bdc2e).

The batch execution-boundary re-derivation (Fix 3) compares against a hash derived from the same args object, so it is not externally triggerable; the externally triggerable drift checks are the action_context_hash check (F5) and batch recipient_allocation_hash binding (F7-F9).

recipientAllocationHash is order-canonical (sorted), so pure reordering of identical pairs is invisible by design while address/amount/redistribution drift is caught; the verbatim docstring's 'silent reordering' claim overstates the check.
The fixture runs offline (no RPC/relay/telemetry) on zod, viem, canonicalize, md5, reflect-metadata, Node >= 20; the blob-SHA check makes silent drift of the tested code detectable on re-runs.

limits: This result covers the exact tested revision (PR #1349 head 8380c34…). It does not cover later PR heads (15bdc2e…, 1c2330e…, 1d16d0a…, 9d28b41…, 746975e…, e5cbc7a…) or any merged main revision; FINDING-1 records where the tested head diverges from the fixed head.

The fixture executes the verbatim implementation against a recording mock wallet and configurable policy fakes. It does not touch a chain, sign a real transaction, contact the relay, or send analytics.
Blob identities are git blob SHAs (sha1('blob <len>\0' + content)) matching the GitHub blobs at the tested head tree; re-verifiable with the script in PROVENANCE.md.

The fixture is a supplementary, offline-rerunnable conformance asset. Native verification (tsc + full Jest) is the canonical gate for the PR; fixture results are author-reported, as acknowledged in-thread.
The fixture accepts no credentials, wallet IDs, signatures, transactions, or raw provider responses as input, and it makes no claim about any other provider, revision, or fork.
Three harness-side substitutions (wallet-providers/network indexes, analytics no-op) are documented in PROVENANCE.md and are not part of the conformance target.
